fusions.name: Budded Spur
fusions.desc: Snaps a budded spur off in one enemy for 8 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, one for each bud; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spore Spawning
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of spawn that deals 26 damage, ignoring resistances, to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. The poison spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 5.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Symbiont Shallows
fusions.desc: Raises a reef of weed and polyp where you stand for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. Each ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Algal Plating
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
